info.name: Adobe Experience Platform Data Collection Builds Edge Network API API

params.name: datastreamId
params.description: The ID of the datastream configured in Adobe Experience Platform for data routing and processing.

params.name: requestId
params.description: An optional external request tracing ID. If not provided, the Edge Network generates one automatically.

items.docs: Send a single event to the Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network and receive a response with personalization decisions, identity stitching, and other real-time results. This endpoint does not support batch events; use the collect endpoint for multiple events.

params.name: datastreamId
params.description: The ID of the datastream configured in Adobe Experience Platform for data routing and processing.

params.name: requestId
params.description: An optional external request tracing ID. If not provided, the Edge Network generates one automatically.

params.name: silent
params.description: When true, returns 204 No Content with an empty payload instead of the standard response.

items.docs: Send one or more events to the Adobe Experience Platform Edge Network for non-interactive data collection. Supports batch processing of multiple events in a single request. Use the silent query parameter to receive a 204 response with no payload.
